title: "Debate Papers: Will the global trading system survive President Trump’s tariffs"
date: "2018-09-04"

In the latest installment of the United States Studies Centre’s [Debate Papers](https://www.ussc.edu.au/analysis/the-debate-papers-will-the-global-trading-system-survive-president-trumps-tariffs) series, Alan Oxley takes the affirmative and I take the negative on whether the global trading system will survive President Trump’s tariffs.
